## Core Competencies & Verified Technical Stack

### 1. Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning
- **Local LLM Inference on Consumer Hardware**: Quantization (INT4 / INT3 / INT2 GPTQ, AWQ), PyTorch, CUDA kernel optimizations, low-rank residual adapters. Successfully ran 7B Mistral at 23.4 tokens/sec on 4 GB VRAM GPUs (2.4 GB memory footprint).
- **Conversational AI & Multimodal Agents**: Multi-agent architectures (Dexter, OpenClaw), Vector RAG (retrieval-augmented generation), voice note transcription, image understanding, WhatsApp Cloud API integrations (CORA, Nexo).
- **Machine Learning & Simulation**: Monte Carlo simulations, XGBoost regressors, Elo rating engines over 50,000+ historical datasets (Mundial 2026 Predictor).
- **Computer Vision & Reinforcement Learning**: Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), OpenCV, screen visual parsing without prior game state access (Dino AI).

### 2. 3D, Physics Engines & Interactive Multimedia
- **WebGL & WebAssembly (WASM)**: Unity 2D/3D compilation to browser, custom Eulerian-Lagrangian material harvesting physics and concrete pouring simulation (Obra Maestra MN).
- **In-Browser Video & Audio Composition**: Real-time canvas rendering, multitrack timeline scrubber, audio-video pipeline with generative AI assist (Web Studio).
- **Three.js & Custom GLSL Shaders**: Orbital physics, procedural starfields, celestial lighting (Ourway).

### 3. Full-Stack Web, PWAs & Enterprise Systems
- **Frontend & Offline-First PWAs**: React, TypeScript, modern JavaScript, Tailwind CSS, Service Workers, indexed databases (IndexedDB, Dexie, OPFS, SQLite WASM), zero-cloud private finance (MyAccountant).
- **Backend Architecture & APIs**: Python, FastAPI, Node.js, Express, RESTful APIs, asynchronous event queues, official WhatsApp Business API integration.
- **Databases & DevOps**: PostgreSQL, Firebase Firestore, SQL Server, Redis, Docker containerization, CI/CD automated deployments, Linux administration.
- **Enterprise ERP & Field Operations**: End-to-end inventory management, quoting, billing, and scanner automation (Núcleo ERP, Vértice, Vitrina).
